samples.question: The image shows several closed black rings drawn on a white background. A ring seals off its own white pocket, and the white area outside all the rings is one further white region. Three small colored dots - one red, one green, one blue - are placed in the picture. Two dots are in the SAME white region when they sit in the same continuous white area (the same sealed pocket, or the same connected outside area), reachable from one to the other without crossing any black ring ink. Exactly two of the three dots lie in the same white region; the third lies in a different one. Which two colored dots are in the same white region? Answer with exactly one of red-green, red-blue, or green-blue.
